question: Select the most suitable word from the passage which means ‘scattered’.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4) i.e. "**Dispersed**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Scattered**: (बिखरे हुए) - Spread over a wide area in a disorganized manner.

 
 
• **Example**: The scattered toys made the room look messy.
